stem.text: Aqueous hydrogen peroxide, $\text{H}_2\text{O}_2$, decomposes into water and oxygen in the presence of a suitable catalyst.
$50\ \text{cm}^3$ of a $0.50\ \text{mol dm}^{-3}$ solution of hydrogen peroxide produced $120\ \text{cm}^3$ of oxygen in 2.0 minutes.
The volume of gas was measured at room conditions.
What is the average rate of decomposition of hydrogen peroxide during this 2.0 minute period?
